name: Cebu New Year Open 2026

venue.name: Banilad Town Centre

information: ## **Welcome to the 2nd World Cube Association Cebu New Year Open!** This competition marks the second year kick-off competition held in Cebu City. The event is open to anyone able to solve a cube. All other necessary information about the competition can be found in the following tabs above. Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating. ###### *By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition.*
